For group rGroup and its member rd, return JSON with exactly delay (the group common delay), spread (the member residual) and at (the member performed onset). Use reduced rational strings.

Create exactly four notes, in this note-array order: wa (pitch 63, duration 395/256, velocity 95, spread 0); wb (pitch 67, duration 453/512, velocity 102, spread 3/256); wc (pitch 70, duration 473/512, velocity 84, spread 1/64); wd (pitch 74, duration 485/512, velocity 62, spread 1/32). No other notes, groups or properties.
Change only the velocity of the note at 4499/512 with pitch 35 to 91. Preserve all other performed state.
Transpose only the note at 1537/256 with pitch 29 up two semitones. Preserve its duration (not its end time), onset and velocity, and every other note.

Halve every spread in group hGroup. Preserve its anchor, common delay, note durations/pitches/velocities, membership, orders, labels and provenance, and every other note and group. Keep the group equation and explicit or derived onsets consistent.
Move every note whose onset is at least 6 and less than 8 later by 1/8. Preserve their durations (not end times), pitches and velocities, and every other note.
Delete only the note at 4499/512 with pitch 35. Preserve every field of every other note.

Delete the note with pitch 64 whose onset is at least 2 and less than 3. Select only by that pitch and onset range; do not choose by ID, duration, velocity or order. If the selector matches more than one note, return REFUSE ambiguous-selector.
Return the complete note state unchanged, preserving multiplicity, pitch, onset, duration and velocity.
Return the entire fixture unchanged, including exact rational spellings, original note order, all channels/expression/conditional state, and opaque annotations. Do not invent musical intent.
